_readme: University Voting — Email Service workflow (EXAMPLE / SAFE TO COMMIT)
1. Copy this file:  cp email_service.example.json email_service.json
2. Import email_service.json into n8n  (Workflows → Import from file)
3. In n8n go to Settings → Variables and add:
N8N_INTERNAL_TOKEN = <same value as N8N_INTERNAL_TOKEN in your .env>
Credentials → New → Gmail OAuth2 → sign in with Google
Open the imported workflow → click the Gmail node → select that credential
DO NOT commit email_service.json — it is in .gitignore
